item.title: Khejarli: The Forest of Martyrs - RJ Venika Lakshmi
item.description:
VIT Community Radio remembers the brave martyrs of Khejarli, Rajasthan, who sacrificed their lives to protect trees nearly 300 years ago in 1730. Hear the inspiring story of Amrita Devi and the Bishnoi community, who stood for nature and conservation. Listen to RJ Venika Lakshmi as she revisits this powerful legacy.

Language: Tamil

item.title: Choose Hope, Choose Life - An Interaction with VIT Counsellors
item.description:
On World Suicide Prevention Day, VIT Community Radio brings together VIT Counsellors Dr. Jetson Satya Gospel, Ms. Akalya R S, Ms. Haritha M, and Ms. Rajshree SV for an insightful conversation on suicide awareness and prevention. Hosted by RJ Pavi, the special show explores mental well-being, emotional struggles, stigma, prevention, self-belief, and the importance of seeking support.

Through professional perspectives and practical insights, the episode encourages open conversations, empathy, and understanding. It aims to break the silence, challenge misconceptions, promote mindful support, and remind listeners that reaching out, listening without judgement, and seeking professional help can make a meaningful difference.

Language: Tamil

Learn the importance of listening, offering support, and connecting people with qualified mental health professionals this World Suicide Prevention Day.

item.title: Read a book, Change your World - RJ Anushree
item.description:
A book can take us places we have never been, introduce us to ideas we have never imagined, and transform the way we see the world. In this special talk, RJ Anushree explores the joy and power of reading and how making time for books can enrich our imagination, knowledge, and everyday lives. Tune in and discover why sometimes, all it takes to begin a new journey is to turn a page.

Keep your surroundings clean, eliminate stagnant water, and stay protected.

item.title: Family: The Anchor of Life - RJ Abi Godson
item.description:
Do you know what serves as a fundamental anchor in life? The answer is family.

VIT Community Radio brings you a special talk by RJ Abi Godson on the International Day of Family Remittances. More than 200 million migrant workers support their families across the globe through remittances, contributing significantly to the economic well-being of households and nations alike. Many of these workers carefully manage their finances and make personal sacrifices to ensure that a portion of their earnings reaches their loved ones back home.

Tune in to learn more about the vital role migrant workers play in strengthening families and communities worldwide.

Language: English

item.title: Chatty Chatty: Building IT Careers with SHINE
item.description:
VIT Community Radio brings you a special career guidance feature on IT skill development through the SHINE (Skill Enhancement & Employability) Program by Universal Higher Education Trust (UHET), Vellore. In this engaging chatty-chatty conversation, RJ RSK speaks with Dr. Sundar Raj, Assistant Project Director, UHET, about how the SHINE initiative by Pearltri Foundation and Aspire Systems supports youth from small towns and rural regions to build a successful career in the IT sector.

The three-month training program at VIT, Vellore offers industry-relevant learning, expert faculty, and a monthly stipend of ₹5,000, with no training fees or bonds. Graduates aged 20–24 with B.Sc. (Mathematics/Computer Science) or BCA can apply and explore new opportunities in the IT field through this career-focused initiative.

Google Form for Registration: https://tinyurl.com/yckxebvy

Language: Tamil

item.description:

Through this reflection, we celebrate love not just as a feeling, but as a journey — one that teaches patience, understanding, and trust in destiny.


Here’s to love that finds its path and endures beyond time. Happy Valentine’s Day.

item.description:
This Valentine’s Day, RJ Hasika invites you to celebrate connection in its truest form — the kind built on patience, kindness, and understanding. Love isn’t just about grand gestures or dates; it lives in the small words of care, the quiet support we give, and the warmth we share with those around us.


Take a moment to express love to the people who matter, to appreciate the bonds that hold you steady, and most importantly, to be gentle with yourself. Real love begins within and grows when shared.


Here’s to meaningful connections, heartfelt words, and love that feels honest and enduring. Happy Valentine’s Day.

RJ Logeshwari, RJ Shruthi, RJ Arun, RJ Vilashini, RJ Aghasthi, and RJ Vimal bring together these conversations, capturing the connection and warmth that radio continues to create.

Stay tuned! Don’t miss the “Radio Rey Dio” Anthem, powered by Suno AI and written with our own original lyrics, coming up at the end of the show, specially produced for World Radio Day by VIT Community Radio.

item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents a thoughtful dialogue that bridges legacy and learning. In this special episode, we feature an engaging interview with E. S. Dinesh Raghavan, Associate Professor and Assistant Director (Students’ Welfare), VIT Vellore.


Hosted by RJ Sriganth, the conversation explores the soul of heritage architecture—Tamil legacy sites, time-honoured buildings, and the disciplined craft of documenting them for future generations. Tune in as VIT Community Radio invites you to learn from this rich interaction—where the past speaks, the present listens, and the future is thoughtfully designed.

item.title: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Jayanti - RJ Raghav
item.description:
VIT Community Radio 90.8 pays tribute to one of India’s most fearless freedom fighters — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. Through powerful words and reflection, this presentation revisits Netaji’s courage, sacrifice, and unwavering belief that freedom is not gifted, but earned through struggle and unity.

The episode highlights Netaji’s bold decisions, his call to the youth, and the spirit of Azad Hind that continues to echo in every breath of an independent India. It reminds listeners that true patriotism lies in standing against injustice and placing the nation before self.

This episode serves as a heartfelt reminder of the price of freedom and the responsibility that comes with it — to live consciously, courageously, and for the country first.

Jai Hind.


Language: Hindi

Host: RJ Raghav

Organized by the School of Social Sciences and Languages, VIT Vellore, in collaboration with the Consulate-General of Japan, Chennai this conversation — hosted by Dr. Visalakshi — gently unfolds the art, culture, and soulful essence behind Japan’s timeless tea ceremony tradition.

🫖 Sip in the calm. Listen to the culture.

Language: English

item.title: Insights of COMFEST 2025 - A Roundup Interaction
item.description:
Step into the vibrant world of COMFEST 2025 through an exclusive roundup interaction with the dedicated committee members who are shaping this grand celebration. From guest care to finance, from technical events to cultural spectacles — each voice reflects passion, teamwork, and an unyielding commitment to excellence.

Join RJ Akshaya and RJ Himani as they engage with the driving forces behind the scenes — Harshitha from Guest Care, Pooja heading Non-Technical Events, Yashwant from the Disciplinary Committee, Abejay Vel from Documentation, Sowmiya from Programme Scheduling, Akshaya leading Technical Events, Nirupama Seshadri from Registration, Prashastha from Staging, Design and Decoration, Hari Shri Ram from Food and Hospitality, Samyuktha from Cultural Events, Sivapriya from Certification, and Iniya Dharsheni from the Finance Committee.

Tune in to hear their stories of preparation, perseverance, and passion — as COMFEST 2025 readies itself for an unforgettable journey of creativity, innovation, and collaboration!

Language: English

item.description:

item.title: Insights of COMFEST 2025 - Dr. Shyam Sundar
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents exclusive insights from COMFEST 2025 – where learning meets practical commerce! In this episode, RJ Akshaya hosts a short interview with Dr. Shyam Sundar. They discuss how COMFEST guides students on where to innovate and where to stick to proven methods, blending academic knowledge with real-world practice. Emphasising teamwork over groupism, they highlight how collaboration drives success in both technical and non-technical sessions. Tune in for an inspiring take on learning, skill-building, and victory through collaboration!

Language: English

item.title: ICADBSL 2025 Exclusive: Guest of Honour - Mr. Bharath Kumar A M
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents an exclusive interview with Mr. Bharath Kumar A M, Founder and Principal Designer of Studio Cove, Bengaluru, and Guest of Honor at ICADBSL 2025, held at VIT Vellore.

In this engaging conversation hosted by RJ Akshaya, Mr. Bharath Kumar highlights the importance of innovation, continuous learning, and modern adaptation—with sustainability as the core theme of his design philosophy.

Tune in for inspiring insights on how creativity and conscious design can drive a sustainable future.

item.title: ICADBSL 2025 Exclusive: Chief Guest - Ms. Shilpi Tandan
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents an exclusive interview with Ms. Shilpi Tandan, Associate Director, KPMG Global Services, Bengaluru, and Chief Guest at ICADBSL 2025, held at VIT Vellore.

In this engaging conversation hosted by RJ Akshaya, Ms. Tandan emphasizes the importance of cultivating saving habits among the younger generation and encourages youth to support elders in adapting to technology.

Tune in for a thoughtful discussion on financial wisdom, intergenerational learning, and social responsibility.

item.title: ICADBSL 2025 Exclusive: Keynote Speaker - Dr Ritu Tyagi
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents an exclusive interview with Dr. Ritu Tyagi, Keynote Speaker at ICADBSL 2025, held at the School of Social Sciences and Languages (SSL), VIT Vellore.

In this insightful conversation hosted by Dr. Visalakshi, Dr Tyagi shares her perspectives on rethinking interculturality in foreign language teaching and learning in India, exploring how cultural understanding shapes effective communication and education in a globalised world.

Tune in for an engaging dialogue that bridges languages, cultures, and minds.

item.title: TechKey Talk - graVITas 25' - A Short Interview With Capital Hunt Investor - Dr Periasamy Pradeep Ravichandran
item.description: VIT Community Radio presents a special graVITas 25’ feature with Dr. Periasamy Pradeep Ravichandran, Investopreneur and Founder of BiggDa Venture Investment. As a guest for Capital Hunt, he shared his expertise and vision with students passionate about startups and entrepreneurship. BiggDa Venture Investment is a venture capital firm where Dr. Ravichandran has contributed to the growth of over 53 startups with a strong focus on AI & ML, business development, and innovation. In his interaction, he emphasized the importance of building ideas with purpose, resilience, and adaptability. His words encouraged students to think big, take risks, and shape their entrepreneurial journey with confidence. Stay tuned with VIT Community Radio for more inspiring updates from graVITas 25’.

item.title: TechKey Talk - graVITas 25' - A Short Interview With Dr. Shashank Shah, Director of NITI Aayog, India - Guest Of Honour
item.description: VIT Community Radio presents a special graVITas 25’ Valedictory feature with Guest of Honor Dr. Shashank Shah, Director of NITI Aayog, India. He also highlighted how such events enable students to enhance their skills, integrate knowledge, and prepare for future challenges. As part of graVITas 25', Cashflow 4.0 is not just a game—it’s a fun, hands-on journey to financial literacy and wealth-building. item.description:

The sixth edition of this flagship event is perfect for beginners and enthusiasts alike, exploring the fundamentals of hardware and embedded systems. item.title: TechKey Talk - Pulse Of graVITas 25' - FPGA Prototyping Summit
item.description:
Let’s tune in to the FPGA Prototyping Summit shoutout on VIT Community Radio, where students get hands-on with the digital future—one bit at a time. This one-day workshop takes you through Verilog-based RTL design and the complete FPGA design flow, from coding and simulation to deployment on real DE2-115 FPGA boards using Intel Quartus Prime. No prior experience? No problem! Industry experts from LeadSoc Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore, will also share insights into semiconductor trends and career opportunities. Stay connected with VIT Community Radio for updates, and get ready to design, test, and implement your own digital circuits at the FPGA Prototyping Summit!

item.title: TechKey Talk - Pulse Of graVITas 25' - Robowars
item.description:
Let’s tune in to the Robowars shoutout on VIT Community Radio, where engineering meets adrenaline! As the flagship event of graVITas, Robowars brings India’s biggest combat robotics arena to life, featuring 8kg, 15kg, and 60kg bots battling nonstop for glory. With over 40 war machines from teams across the globe, this high-octane spectacle promises thrilling round-the-clock action in the country’s largest and safest arena. Stay connected with VIT Community Radio for updates, and get ready to witness power, strategy, and sparks fly at Robowars!

The event showcases a spectacular blend of art and technology with laser shows, LED wing performances, glow-in-the-dark acts, and high-energy dance sequences. Splendera promises to be a dazzling celebration that adds brilliance to the graVITas experience.

item.title: TechKey Talk: Capital Hunt – The Entrepreneurial Quest of graVITas 25’
item.description:
Capital Hunt at graVITas 25’ is more than just a competition — it’s a journey into the world of entrepreneurship. Participants step into the shoes of innovators and investors, pitching ideas, crafting strategies, and navigating real-time challenges that mirror the dynamic business world. With mentorship from leading investors and industry experts, the event is designed to test creativity, negotiation skills, financial acumen, and teamwork.

It’s not just about winning investments — it’s about discovering how ideas transform into opportunities and how challenges turn into stepping stones for growth. Capital Hunt is where future entrepreneurs are forged.

item.title: TechKey Talk – graVITas 25’ – Powering the Web & Tech
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents Techkey Talk: Powering the Web & Tech from graVITas 25', hosted by RJ Aarthi with Web & Tech Committee Student Organiser Prateek and Manager Dev. This episode dives into how the department builds and manages the digital backbone of graVITas 25'—from developing websites and handling online platforms to ensuring seamless tech support. Prateek and Dev share behind-the-scenes experiences, challenges of coordinating a large-scale fest, and the excitement of creating solutions that connect thousands of participants. With RJ Aarthi steering the conversation, listeners gain an engaging look at the pivotal role of Web & Tech in driving innovation and smooth experiences at graVITas 25'.

item.title: graVITas 25' – From Haunted Nights to Thrilling Fights
item.description:
Step into the eerie halls of VIT where whispers of flickering lights and metallic clashes stir the night. But what seems like a haunting soon transforms into the electrifying energy of graVITas 2025. From RoboWars under the spotlight to all-night hackathons, glowing workshops, and clubs unveiling their magic — this is no ghost story. It’s the ultimate tech fest where fear turns into fascination and thrills never stop. The only thing scary? Missing it.

item.title: Exchange of Ideas: The Next Waves-Young Engineers shaping a sustainable future
item.description:
VIT Community Radio, in collaboration with Solar Energy Society of India – VIT (SESI.VIT), presents another impactful episode of Exchange of Ideas: “The Next Wave: Young Engineers Shaping a Sustainable Future.”

Hosted by Dr. Debashish Dash and RJ Suchetana, the session showcases the vision of SESI.VIT participants Ananya SSSV, Aditya Pratap Singh Jadon, P. Aditya, and Nandita Subramani, who discuss innovative solutions ranging from community solar grids and top-to-bottom irrigation systems to engineering approaches tackling water scarcity. Moving beyond concepts, they explore how miniature models can evolve into real-time projects, shaping practical pathways for sustainable development.

With content curated by Vignesh V and D. S. Mugundan, this episode highlights how young engineers are reimagining renewable energy and sustainable practices to create a brighter, greener tomorrow.

Language: English

item.title: Peace Is Always Stronger Than War - RJ Pranathi
item.description:

item.title: Sudhanthira Thaagam: IDC 2025 Special Podcast
item.description:
VIT Community Radio 90.8 proudly presents a special podcast, "Sudhanthira Thaagam" — Independence Day Celebrations by School Students from Vellore. This vibrant compilation of patriotic performances was recorded during the Independence Day competitions held from 28th to 31st July 2025 at our VIT Community Radio.

A total of 261 enthusiastic students (Grade 6 to 12) from 20 schools in and around Vellore showcased their talents across eight exciting categories, including Talk, Song, Drama & Quiz, in both Tamil and English. Their spirited contributions reflect not only their creativity but also their deep love for the nation.

Relive the passion, energy, and patriotic spirit of these young voices. Find your favourite performance and share it on your social media to spread the joy of Independence Day with VIT Community Radio 90.8.

Language: Tamil & English

item.title: Arivom Aayirom : Nam Desia Kodi
item.description:
VIT Community Radio brings you another episode of Arivom Aayirom "Nam Desiya Kodi " in celebration of National Flag Day(22.07.2025). Join us as we explore the stories, values, and emotions woven into the threads of our national flag, the Tiranga. From its historical journey to the meaning behind each color and symbol, this special show reflects the pride, unity, and freedom our flag stands for. Hear voices from the VIT community as they share what the flag means to them. Let’s come together to honour the symbol that unites us all — only on VIT Community Radio.


Language: Tamil

Hosts: RJ RSK, RJ Sakthivel, RJ Swathi & Dr. Visalakshi

item.title: Vallunar Paarvai: Harvesting Organic Success
item.description:
Vallunar Paarvai, an exclusive interview series on VIT Community Radio, brings forth insightful conversations with individuals who have made remarkable contributions to society. In this episode, Dr. Visalakshi engages in an enriching dialogue with Mr. Senthamil Selvan, a retired bank employee who has transformed his passion for farming into a thriving venture as an organic farmer and Agripreneur.

Beyond his personal journey in organic farming, Mr. Senthamil Selvan actively contributes to agricultural community development through various initiatives. He spearheads an Agri Library, enabling farmers and enthusiasts to access valuable resources on sustainable farming practices. His knowledge-sharing sessions serve as a platform for farmers to exchange innovative ideas and traditional wisdom. Additionally, he organizes Makkal Nala Sandhai, a monthly agri-market that connects local farmers directly with consumers, promoting organic produce and rural entrepreneurship.

Tune in to Vallunar Paarvai to explore Mr. Senthamil Selvan’s inspiring transition from the banking sector to agriculture and his impactful efforts in fostering a self-sustaining farming community!

Language: Tamil

item.title: Flowing Towards Change - RJ Geethapriya
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents a special talk with RJ Geethapriya on the International Day of Action for Rivers! March 14th marks a global call to protect these vital lifelines—80% of the world depends on rivers, yet 50% are polluted. From the dying Yamuna to the shrinking Aral Sea, the crisis is real. Act now—reduce waste, conserve water, and save our rivers!

item.title: Safety First: National Safety Day Special With RJ Raghav Sanoria
item.description:
VIT Community Radio 90.8 FM presents the National Safety Day episode with RJ Raghav Sanoria! Observed annually on March 4th, #NationalSafetyDay raises awareness about safety, health, and environmental measures across workplaces, schools, and communities. It serves as a reminder to adopt safe practices, prevent accidents, and foster a culture of well-being. This year’s theme, “Enhancing Safety Culture for a Better Future,” urges individuals and organizations to prioritize safety in all aspects of life. Whether it’s workplace hazards, road safety, or digital security, every small step toward safety can make a big difference!

Language: English

Stay safe, stay aware! Keep listening to VIT Community Radio 90.8 FM for more updates! 🚦🔒🎧 #StaySafe #SafetyFirst #WorkplaceSafety #RoadSafety #DigitalSecurity #VITCommunityRadio

item.description:
Join us on VIT Community Radio 90.8 FM for the thirteenth episode of Moothoruku Mudhal Vanakkam, a program dedicated to the well-being of senior citizens. This episode sheds light on various government and community initiatives aimed at supporting elderly individuals who live alone.

With expert insights and real-life testimonials, we discuss financial assistance schemes, healthcare programs, helpline services, and social engagement initiatives designed to enhance the quality of life for seniors facing solitude. Backed by resources from the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment and community welfare organizations, we bring you essential information to help our elders lead a secure and fulfilling life.

Tune in on Wednesday at 9:30 AM, with a repeat telecast on Friday at the same time. Let’s work together to ensure care, dignity, and support for our elderly loved ones!

item.title: Remembering Martin Luther King Jr.'s Impact - RJ Ann Mariya
item.description:

His enduring influence continues to motivate future generations to work for a compassionate world.

Language: English

item.title: Martin Luther King Jr. Day - Celebrating His Life and Legacy - RJ Shikha Shiwani
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents RJ Shikha Shiwani's special talk on Martin Luther King Jr. Day on his legacy which is a powerful testament to the transformative impact of nonviolent resistance and the pursuit of justice. His leadership in the civil rights movement led to monumental advancements which dismantled institutionalized racism and secured fundamental rights for African Americans.

Globally, his philosophy of nonviolence inspired leaders and movements fighting for freedom and equality, from South Africa's anti-apartheid struggle to human rights efforts worldwide. His iconic "I Have a Dream" speech remains a timeless call for unity, hope, and equality. Honored annually on Martin Luther King Jr. Day , his enduring influence continues to inspire generations to fight for a more just and compassionate world.

Language: Hindi

item.title: Moothoruku Mudhal Vanakkam - Episode 10: Kumbamela Special & Muthiyor Paathugappu
item.description:
Tune in to VIT Community Radio 90.8 FM for the tenth episode of "Moothoruku Mudhal Vanakkam", a program dedicated to enhancing the lives of senior citizens. This special episode sheds light on the safety of elders, focusing on measures to ensure their well-being during large gatherings like the Kumbamela. Supported by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment and the Community Radio Association, the episode delves into safety tips, precautionary measures, and resources to prevent elder abuse and promote security.

Catch the broadcast on Thursday at 9:30 AM, with repeat telecasts on Friday at the same time. Join us to empower our senior citizens with the knowledge they deserve.

Language: Tamil

item.title: Special Pongal Wishes from Dr. G. Viswanathan
item.description:
As we celebrate the vibrant harvest festival of Pongal, Dr. G. Viswanathan, Founder and Chancellor of VIT, Mr. Sankar Viswanathan, Vice President of VIT, and Dr. Sandhya Pentareddy, Executive Director of VIT, extend their heartfelt wishes, sharing joy, prosperity, and togetherness with everyone. Dr. Visalakshi interviews these esteemed leaders, highlighting their thoughts on the spirit of Pongal and the importance of gratitude and harmony. May this auspicious occasion bring happiness, good health, and success to all as we embrace the festive cheer together! ⁠

item.title: Lights, Camera, Action - VIT Business School - RJ Soorya
item.description:
Lights, Camera, Action! 🎬 A vibrant short video competition organized by VIT Business School lit up the Dr. Ambedkar Auditorium on December 11, 2024. The event unleashed the creative energy of students, challenging them to narrate their Business School journey and team spirit in just 45-60 seconds.

VIT Community Radio captured the essence of this dynamic event in a special radio magazine. Featuring heartfelt stories from the Dean, HODs, faculty, judges (both internal and external), student organizers, participants, and winners, the program showcased the event's impact. Their reflections highlighted how Lights, Camera, Action! not only celebrated creativity but also inspired collaboration and innovation across the Business School community.

Language: English & Tamil

item.title: Special Radio Roundup: RAWE-VAIAL-VIT-Vellore
item.description:
Tune in to a special edition on VIT Community Radio as we explore the impactful Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) program at VIT Vellore! In this episode, hear from:

🌾 Dr. G. Viswanathan, Chancellor of VIT, sharing his visionary thoughts on the future of agriculture.

🌱 Dr. Rajendran R, Dean of VAIAL, VIT, discussing the framework and goals of the RAWE program.

🎓 Faculty, external evaluators, and students reflecting on their hands-on experiences during the RAWE initiative.

👩‍🌾 Farmers also join the conversation, sharing their valuable insights and experiences in the field.

Don't miss out on this fascinating interviews at the intersection of education, innovation, and rural development, only on VIT Community Radio! 🎧

Language: Tamil & English

item.title: Epilepsy First Response: A Guide for Everyone - RJ Vaibhavi
item.description:
On National Epilepsy Day, VIT Community Radio’s special segment by RJ Vaibhavi talks about Epilepsy and provides essential steps to follow when witnessing an epileptic seizure:

  • Stay calm and offer reassurance to others around.
  • Move dangerous objects away to prevent injury.
  • Turn the person onto their side to help keep their airway clear.
  • Time the seizure to monitor its duration.
  • Do not restrain the person or attempt to hold them down.
  • Avoid placing anything in their mouth.
  • Stay with them until they regain awareness.

Tune in for more details on providing compassionate care during a seizure.

Language: English

item.title: தமிழின் பெருமை; தமிழரின் பெருமை: Tamil Pride
item.description:
Insights from the 36th Pavendar Bharathidasan Tamil Mandram Event விஐடி பண்பலை 90.8, விஐடியின் சமுதாய வானொலியில் பாவேந்தர் பாரதிதாசன் தமிழ் மன்றத்தின் 36 ஆம் ஆண்டு துவக்க விழாவின் சிறப்பு தொகுப்பு. இத்தொகுப்பில் வி ஐடியின் வேந்தர் கல்விக்கோ முனைவர் கோ. விஸ்வநாதன் மற்றும் தஞ்சை தமிழ் பல்கலைக்கழகத்தின் மேனாள் துணை வேந்தர் மற்றும் செம்மொழி மத்திய உயராய்வு நிறுவனத்தின் மேனாள் துணைத்தலைவர் முனைவர் இ. சுந்தரமூர்த்தி அவர்களின் உரைகளைக் கேட்கலாம்.
VIT Community Radio's special broadcast of the 36th Inaugural Ceremony of the Pavendar Bharathidasan Tamil Mandram features speeches by Dr. Viswanathan, Chancellor of VIT, and Dr. Sundaramurthy, former Vice-Chancellor of Thanjavur Tamil University and former Vice President of the Semmozhi Central Research Institute. Language: Tamil

item.title: Honoring Postal Legacy - RJ Damini
item.description:
Join VIT Community Radio on this special occasion of National Post Day, where RJ Damini discusses the enduring legacy of postal services in India. She reflects on how letters have connected people for centuries, long before the internet and mobile phones. From traditional mail to modern banking services, RJ Damini highlights the crucial role of post offices in reaching even the most remote corners of the country.

Tune in as we salute the hard work of postal workers and celebrate this vital service that keeps us connected.

Language: Hindi

item.title: Exchange of Ideas: Engineering Beyond Boundaries: Session 2
item.description:
🎧 Tune in to Engineering Beyond Boundaries: Session 2, by VIT Community Radio in collaboration with The Solar Energy Society of India (SESI), as we continue celebrating National Engineers Day! 🚀

In this session, we explore the dynamic fields of Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, and Chemical Engineering. Discover how these disciplines are pivotal in driving sustainable growth and addressing global challenges. Join us as we recognize the remarkable contributions of engineers working to build a brighter, more sustainable future. Don’t miss this engaging discussion!

#NationalEngineersDay #EngineeringExcellence #VITCommunityRadio #SESI

item.title: AIDS Awareness Rally: A Timely Initiative
item.description: VIT Community Radio's RJ Sarathy and RJ Srinivasan covered an AIDS Awareness Rally from Chittoor Bus Stand to VIT Main Gate, organized today by the Vellore Collectorate and VIT, with support from the Management, faculty, students, and staff. Dr. Partha Sharathi Mallick, Pro-Vice Chancellor of VIT Vellore, Prof. Jayakrishnan, NSS and RRC Coordinator, and Dr. Anandha Chitra, District Programme Manager of the AIDS Prevention & Control Unit, Vellore, shared their messages with the public at the event, emphasizing the need for AIDS awareness and community engagement.

item.title: Kick the Habit: RJ Shanjana on World Lung Cancer Day
item.description:

Explore the remarkable process our bodies go through when we quit smoking and learn about the timeline for lung recovery. Gain valuable knowledge and inspiration to make a positive change. Tune in to understand how you can kick the habit and embrace a healthier future.

Language: Tamil

item.title: Triumph in Track and Field: A Conversation with A. Govindaraj
item.description: VIT Community Radio presents "VIT Achievers," hosted by RJ Jeevan. In this episode, RJ Jeevan chats with Mr. A. Govindaraj, who won medals in the PEGASUS-2024, a national-level tournament organized by Christian Medical College & Hospital, Vellore. Mr. Govindaraj secured the Gold in Discus Throw, Silver in Shot Put, and Bronze in Javelin Throw. This discussion explores into his inspiring sports journey, highlighting his challenges, perseverance, and ultimate triumphs. Tune in to hear about the falls and rises that shaped a champion.

item.description: On VIT Community Radio, join RJ Anand & Dr. Visalakshi for the episode of "Arivom Aayiram: Short Stories." In this captivating episode, Dr. Visalakshi, an Assistant Professor in French at VIT Vellore, shares her insights into the world of short stories. Tune in for an enlightening journey through timeless tales that offer a profound look into the human experience.

item.title: Karasaram: Social Media & Tech Nalladha? Kettadha?
item.description: Join VIT Community Radio's "Karasaram," where diverse voices converge to discuss the impact of social media and technology. Featuring participants from DKM and Auxilium College, the team exploring the positive sides—Mohanapriya, Keerthana, Balambigai, Monisha, Srilekha, Faziya Parveen, Karina, and RJ Manish—highlight the benefits and opportunities. Meanwhile, the team discussing the negative sides—Perarutselvi, Yogalakshmi, Tamilarasi, Vidhya, Reshma, Yuvarani, Harisri, and RJ Anand—delve into the pitfalls and challenges. Tune in for a balanced, thought-provoking dialogue on how social media and technology shape our lives.

Every share adds to the celebration of fatherhood.

item.title: Shining STARS of VIT: 2024
item.description: VIT Community Radio's Special Show on Stars Day 2024 showcasing VIT's philanthropic efforts and featuring special interviews with the guests. Chancellor Dr. G. Viswanathan addressed the audience, emphasizing the significance of education accessibility for rural students. The event welcomed esteemed guests, including legendary Tamil Cinema Director Padmashri Dr. Bharathiraja as the chief guest and veteran Tamil Cinema Producer Kalaipuli S. Thanu as the guest of honor. Their presence added prestige to the occasion, inspiring all attendees with their insights and experiences. The event also saw the participation of various dignitaries, fostering a spirit of unity and support for the STARS initiative.

item.title: Voices of Tomorrow: Stories from Young RJs
item.description:
Tune in to a special episode of Pallikoodam, where we showcase the creative talents of young radio jockeys from our recent workshop for school students. Enjoy a diverse array of topics delivered with passion and creativity by our enthusiastic young RJs.

Featured Stories:

1. Mst. Santosh Kumar - Kanavukul Oru Ulagam: Dive into a world of dreams where imagination knows no bounds.

2. Ms. Janani - Natpu: Explore the depths of friendship and its profound impact on our lives.

3. Mst. Nitishkumar - Samooga Valaithalangalin Thaakangal: Understand the influences of social networks on today's youth and society.

4. Ms. Bhavana - Paritchaiyum Vidamuyarchiyum: A tale of perseverance and the relentless pursuit of success.

5. Mst. Vivekanandan - Panathaal Vaanga Mudiyathu: Discover the invaluable things in life that money simply can't buy.

6. Ms. Archana - Thanga Kodaari Kathai: Immerse yourself in a captivating tale that will ignite your imagination.

7. Ms. Keerthana - Veezhntha Singam: The inspiring journey of a fallen lion that rises against all odds.

8. Ms. Keerthika - Scooby Endra Naaikutty: A delightful story about a little dog named Scooby and its adventures.

9. Ms. Lakshmi Shree - Ethirkaalam Nam Kaiyil: A reflective piece on the power of time in our hands.

10. Ms. Lavanya - Thiramaiyai Kandupidinga: Encouraging us to discover and nurture our hidden talents.

11. Ms. Madhanika - Kaapaatriya Nanban: A heartwarming tale of a friend who saves the day.

12. Ms. Mohana Priya - Avasara Mudivu Thavarana Mudivu: An insightful story about the consequences of hasty decisions.

13. Ms. Swathi - Manthiramum Thiramaiyum: A magical tale that intertwines spells and skills.

14. Ms. Vishnu Priya - Muyarchi Thiruvinaiyaakum: A motivational story that reinforces the value of effort leading to success.

Join us for this creative and motivating episode of Pallikoodam, and be inspired by the budding talents of our young RJs!

item.description: In the second episode of IKKB, Itha Konjam Kelunga Bossu, the series continues to explore self-development and mental health with a focus on the pervasive issue of mobile phone addiction. This episode features an insightful conversation between the host RJ Soorya and psychologist Dr. Nithiyaanandham. They delve into the signs of mobile phone obsession, its impact on mental health, and practical strategies to achieve a healthier balance between online and offline life.

item.title: Future Voices: Special Episode from RJ Workshop for School Students
item.description:
VIT Community Radio presents a special episode of Pallikoodam featuring insightful talks from enthusiastic young RJs who participated in our recent workshop for school students. Tune in to hear diverse and engaging topics delivered with passion and creativity.

  • Keerthika delves into the richness of Thamizh language and its cultural significance.
  • Nithish Kumar explores the power of Nambikai (hope) and its impact on our lives.
  • Archana sheds light on the importance of Electricity in our daily routines.
  • Rakshith talks about the essence of Natpu (friendship).
  • Bhavana discusses the significance of Uravinar(relationships).
  • Saicharan shares insights on Puththagal (innovations).
  • Swathi dances through the world of Nadanam (dance).
  • Varun Raj narrates stories of the Moovendar (three kings).
  • Vishnupriya emphasizes the importance of Kalvi (education).
  • Vivekanandan celebrates the legacy of Thalaivar (leader).
  • Santhosh Kumar speaks on the universal value of Anbu (love).
  • Madanika highlights the virtue of Manithaneyam (humanity).
  • Janani delves into the beauty of Thamizh (Tamil literature).
  • Keerthana talks about the joy of Vilayattu (sports).
  • Mohanapriya discusses the importance of Unavu (food).

Join us for this inspiring and educational episode!

item.title: Vallunar Paarvai: Kalaithaayin Magan Udan Oru Uraiyadal
item.description: Join RJ Saravana Karthick on VIT Community Radio's show "Kalaithaayin Magan Udan Oru Uraiyadal" in the Vallunar Paarvai series as he explores the vibrant world of Tamil folk arts with special guest Mr. Samuel, a Folk Arts Trainer from Kalaithaai Arakattalai in Thiruppatur. Discover the essence of Tamil martial arts, the evolving learning methods for the current generation, and Mr. Samuel's invaluable professional insights. Learn how Kalaithaai Arakattalai is dedicated to preserving and promoting these traditional art forms among society, school students, and youth. For those eager to learn, Mr. Samuel offers training opportunities free of charge. Tune in and immerse yourself in the richness of Tamil culture.

item.title: Constructing Safety: Building Safety Expert Insights
item.description:
பணியிட பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் ஆரோக்கியத்திற்கான உலக தினம் - சிறப்பு நேர்காணல்

On the occasion of World Day for Safety and Health at Work, listen to "Vallunar Paarvai" on VIT Community Radio as RJ Daniel hosts a special interview with Mr. Karthik Rajkumar J, the Building Safety Officer at VIT Vellore. In this enlightening conversation, Mr. Karthik explains various aspects of workplace safety and why it's important for both employees and employers.

From explaining safety rules to comparing India's safety measures with international standards, the conversation covers emergency drills, safety equipment, and the importance of regular training. With helpful answers to questions about safety symbols and community awareness, this interview provides a clear understanding of workplace safety practices. Tune in to learn how to create a safer work environment for everyone.

item.title: Anubava Medai: Organic Odyssey | அனுபவ மேடை - இயற்கையின் வழியில்
item.description:
Join VIT Community Radio's "Anubava Medai" as RJ RSK delves into the world of nutrition with guests Mrs. Rekha Sivakumar, Healthy Food Trainer, and Mr. S. Mukhilan, Organic Farmer. Discover innovative recipes, organic farming practices, and the significance of millets in traditional cuisine.


விஐடி சமுதாய வானொலியின் "அனுபவ மேடை" நிகழ்ச்சியில், ஆரோக்கிய உணவுப் பயிற்சியாளர் திருமதி. ரேகா சிவக்குமார் மற்றும் இயற்கை விவசாயி திரு. S. முகிலன் ஆகியோருடன் RJ RSK ஊட்டச்சத்து தொடர்பான செய்திகளைப் பற்றியும், புதுமையான சமையல் வகைகள், இயற்கை வேளாண்மை நடைமுறைகள் மற்றும் பாரம்பரிய உணவு வகைகளில் தானியங்களின் முக்கியத்துவம் பற்றியும் கலந்துரையாடுவதைக் இந்த போட்காஸ்டில் கேட்கலாம்.

item.title: Daily Talk: Gnapakalu - RJ Janani
item.description:
జ్ఞాపకాలు వెచ్చటి కిరణాలు..!!అలాగే అమ్మమ్మ, నానమ్మ జ్ఞాపకాలు వెచ్చని కిరణాలు లాంటివి. దేవుడు మనకు అమ్మ లాగానే విలని ఇచ్చి అమ్మ లాంటి ప్రేమ మనకు ఇస్తారు .విలు లేని లోటు జీవితం మొత్తం తీరదు.అందుకే విల్ని ఎలాపుడు గౌరవించాలి అలాగే విలకి చాలా ప్రేమ ఐవాలి.
Some memories are like warm hugs and rays.Just like the hugs we get from our grandmothers that can never be compensated. God has given them in our life to see our mom in themselves.we should always remember them and respect them. This is small dedication of tribute of my memories that i relive with my grandmother whom I love a lot.
Language: Telugu

item.title: My Vote, My Duty!
item.description:
வணக்கம், அன்பான வாக்காள பெருமக்களே! 🗳️ இந்த தேர்தல் நாளில், உங்களுக்குள் இருக்கும் சூப்பர் ஹீரோவை வெளியே கொண்டு வாருங்கள்! 💪 நம் ஜனநாயகத்தைக் காக்க, நாம் செய்ய வேண்டிய கடமையை முறையாக செய்யல்லாம், வாருங்கள்.

Hey there, fellow citizens! 🗳️ On election day, let's unleash our inner superheroes and cast our votes! 💪 It's our chance to shape the world we want, and it can be as fun as a superhero mission! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️ So, put on your capes, grab your friends, and let's save democracy together! 🌟💥 #VoteAndMakeADifference #myvotemyduty

Script: RJ Anand
Voice: RJ Anushya & RJ Daniel

item.title: Crafting Magic: Vellore Wood Artisan
item.description: Description: Explore the world of woodcraft with Vellore's finest artisan, Mr. K. Parameswaran, on VIT Community Radio's show "Vallunar Paarvai." Join host RJ Saravana Karthick as he uncovers Parameswaran's experiences and innovative ideas. From the art of crafting the Magic Jug to wood chain crafting and ornamental toy-making, discover a realm of creativity and skill. Gain insights into Parameswaran's unique approach to woodworking, blending tradition with innovation. Don't miss this enlightening interview that promises to inspire and ignite your passion for craftsmanship.

item.title: Dr Sai Saraswathi talks about Birds in VIT Vellore
item.description: Dr. Sai Saraswathi's concise talk delves into the lives of diverse bird species, especially those near the Technology Towers' VIT lake. She also discusses the ornithological interests of our VIT Vice President, Dr. GV Selvam, and his passion for bird sighting. The talk urges action to preserve habitats and recognize the vital role birds play in our ecosystem.

item.title: Sustainability with IGEM
item.description: "In this engaging episode of VIT Community Radio, RJ Pranav, the chairperson of VCR, takes the lead as the main host. Joined by the dynamic co-leads of IGEM, Shashank Venkatesan and L Srimathi, the discussion delves into the pressing issue of harmful pet plastics. Tune in to learn how the IGEM team is working diligently to educate the community about the detrimental effects of pet plastics and discover their innovative strategies to promote sustainability."

item.title: Padhin Parvaigal - EP1
item.description:
In this first episode of Padhin Parvaigal, the host talks about the familiar yet not-so-familiar part of one's adulting process, which is self-love.

The host also shares her experiences in self-love,  about self-love, why is it important, and what can be done to love yourself in a way making you relate to everything that is said, in your everyday life. 

Stay tuned to our podcast to listen to more of these fun and soul-soothing sessions.

item.title: Padhin - Parvaigal
item.description: Getting through this phase of life called “adulating” is not easy! Yup, it’s hard but, it’s not anymore. Teens and baby adults, I welcome you to the exclusive and fun-filled podcast “Padhin Parvaigal” in which the host shares with her audience about anything and everything associated with adulting and how these stuff in real life is dealt with while staying as happy as ever, carving your way through your life even with the endless deadlines and the enormous commitments. Tips, tricks, and fun experiences are on your way. Stay tuned to our podcast to listen to more of these fun and soul-soothing sessions
